history.new: Classical (Cormen et al., ch. 17); see V. Berthe, C. Frougny, M. Rigo, J. Sakarovitch, On the cost and complexity of the successor function, Adv. Appl. Math. 2020 (BFRS) (Historian audit 2026-10-18, reviews/historian_C03_C10.md).
history.old: Standard amortised analysis of counters; frequency argument is folklore.

history.new: Cost measure here: the number of digit positions that change between the representations of n and n+1 (Hamming distance). BFRS use carry propagation, under which the Zeckendorf value is phi^2 instead of 2.

statement:
The average number of digit changes per increment is b/(b-1) in base b, 2 in negabinary, 3/2 in balanced
ternary, e - 1 in the factorial base and exactly 1 in the binary-reflected Gray code.
title: Average cost of counting in classical representations (b/(b-1), e-1, 1)
